prevalence_exact_crossing_0.95.field: p* = 0.95(1-specificity) / (0.05*sensitivity + 0.95(1-specificity)) with sensitivity and specificity held at the frozen observed values; the analytic root of the PF05 grid

complete_resolution_subset_prevalence.field: n_plasmid / n_scored in the complete-resolution isolate subset
